import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageDraw

im = np.asarray(Image.open('/app/radiograph.jpg').convert('L'), dtype=np.float64)

def boxblur(a, r):
    # integral image
    pad = np.pad(a, ((1,0),(1,0)), mode='edge')
    ii = pad.cumsum(0).cumsum(1)
    H,W = a.shape
    ys = np.arange(H); xs = np.arange(W)
    y0 = np.clip(ys-r,0,H-1); y1 = np.clip(ys+r,0,H-1)
    x0 = np.clip(xs-r,0,W-1); x1 = np.clip(xs+r,0,W-1)
    # sum over window using ii
    S = ii[np.ix_(y1+1,x1+1)] - ii[np.ix_(y0,x1+1)] - ii[np.ix_(y1+1,x0)] + ii[np.ix_(y0,x0)]
    N = ((y1-y0+1)[:,None]*(x1-x0+1)[None,:])
    return S/N

bg = boxblur(im, 60)
enh = im - bg
# normalize
lo,hi = np.percentile(enh,1), np.percentile(enh,99)
enh = np.clip((enh-lo)/(hi-lo)*255,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
